privileged_info_for_vlm: The system size must be 5.0 kW DC. Battery capacity must be 10.0 kWh. The replacement threshold is 80% and cost is $300/kWh. The output must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/battery_chemistry_comparison.json. The SAM project file must be named battery_comparison.sam or the script compare_batteries.py. Expected NPV for LFP is typically higher than AGM due to longer cycle life and lower replacement frequency in hot climates like Phoenix.
